scope_caveat: Recall_hat is defined relative to Omega (all 6,137 candidate pairs, i.e. pairs surviving buyer_key + temporal-window blocking) only. It structurally excludes the 1,923 of 3,159 eligible sources that had zero candidates in blocking, so it cannot bound recall against all possible true renewals - only against renewals that could in principle have been found given the current blocking rule.
